lookback_hours.description: Hours of usage and cost data to re-fetch on each sync, to pick up late-arriving and revised data. Minutely streams re-fetch at least the last 24 hours and don't backfill history. Once a month, the first sync after 00:00 UTC on the 9th also re-fetches the previous month, which Anthropic may revise until about seven days after it ends.
lookback_hours.title: Lookback Window (Hours)

access_token.description: An Admin API key (Claude Console organizations) or an Analytics API key with the read:analytics scope (Claude Enterprise organizations).
access_token.title: API Key

start_date.description: UTC date and time in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Any data generated before this date will not be replicated. If left blank, the start date will be set to 30 days before the present. Anthropic serves no data before 2026-01-01 or older than 365 days.
start_date.title: Start Date

organization_type.description: Claude Console organizations are grouped by actor, model, product, API key and workspace. Claude Enterprise organizations are grouped by actor, model, product, speed and context window, since API keys and workspaces are always empty for them. Changing this changes what each row means, so reset and backfill the collections afterwards.
organization_type.title: Organization Type

resourceConfigSchema.description: ResourceConfig is a common resource configuration shape.

interval.description: Interval between updates for this resource
interval.title: Interval
